revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2024 growth 1.3% and FY2025 1.3% were weak; modest recovery toward ~3-4% on service/modernisation growth, fading to 3% toward terminal.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: EBIT margin rose 11.0% (FY23), 11.3% (FY24), 11.9% (FY25) from filed figures; 12.5% assumes continued modest improvement.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 net income to pretax income implies ~26% all-in burden (980.1 vs 1326.8, incl. minorities); Finnish statutory rate 20%, KONE has higher mix of foreign taxes; 25% used.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with Rf 3.266% (ECB 10Y AAA, 2026-11-05) + assumed levered beta ~0.9 x Finland ERP 4.59% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = ~7.4% cost of equity; debt low and cheap so WACC ~7.0%. Beta is my assumption, not looked up.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation ~2%, below Rf of 3.27%.

net_debt.source: not found: ESEF extraction returned null for borrowings/total debt; cash was 440.5M EUR (ifrs-full:CashAndCashEquivalents, FY2025) but debt must be taken from the filing

diluted_shares.source: Derived, not reported by tool: FY2025 net income attributable to owners 980.1M EUR / diluted EPS 1.89 EUR = ~518.6M shares (approximate; verify against the filing)
